Title: Miasma
Writer: Simon Mirren, David Wolstencroft, Andrew Bampfield
Actors: George Blagden, Alexander Vlahos, Tygh Runyan
Plot: Madeleine de Foix is arrested as the poisoner after trying to kill Fabien. Montespans baby suffers an illness. Louis faces criticism from Bossuet and Pascal. Sophie endures a terrifying experience when married to Cassel.
